propositions: Code review tests overlay is currently selected only when a changed file matches test globs, missing cases where product logic is added without test file changes
The tests overlay should fire based on diff content when added declarations are detected, regardless of whether test files were modified
A new content-triggered detector must extract declared names from added lines using language-agnostic regex patterns and verify those names are not also removed in the same file
The trigger must support multiple languages (Python, Go, Rust, JavaScript, TypeScript, Ruby) and work uniformly across any repository layout without CI-provider dependency
Guard criteria for coverage-gap findings must distinguish newly-introduced behavior from pre-existing code, accepting blocking status only when a finding names a concrete violating input
